sources.title: rindo_chihaya_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive DEV_IS]]'s [[Rindo Chihaya]].

It consists of a [[black hat|black]] [[spiked hat|spiked]] [[beret]], a [[black choker]] with a steering wheel pendant [[headphones around neck|headphones around her neck]], a [[long shirt|long]] [[black shirt|black]] [[off-shoulder shirt]] with [[long sleeves|long]] [[raglan sleeves]], worn over a [[white tank top]] and [[purple shorts]] a black [[o-ring thigh strap]] on her right leg and a [[knee strap]] on her left, [[black socks|black]] [[spiked socks|spiked]] [[loose socks]] and [[black shoes|black]] [[high tops]]. She also wears [[multiple rings|multiple]] [[skull ring]]s and has [[steering wheel]]-shaped [[earrings]].

h4. Appearance
